name: How does BIM integration reduce construction errors?

mainEntity.name: How does BIM integration reduce construction errors?

acceptedAnswer.text: By providing precise 3D coordination and embedded specs, BIM catches issues pre-construction, minimizing costly field fixes, rework, and delays from misaligned trades. autodesk​
